_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Re-measured 2026-08-06 after adding the tsify-backed RuntimeIdentity ABI: total 12,222,778; .js 945,837; .wasm 9,119,733; runtime WASM 6,971,167; worker JS 138,632. The named growth is the narrow Rust-to-TypeScript identity DTO plus its serde-wasm-bindgen ABI support; bulk data remains on the existing string/byte boundary. Caps retain about one percent headroom: total 12,350,000; .js 955,000; .wasm 9,220,000; runtime WASM 7,050,000; worker JS 140,000. Earlier baseline rationales remain in git history; any later raise requires a named cause and a fresh production measurement.
